dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pbfb](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pbfb) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 57.548 depth occurred on Feb 05 2025 64km SE of Champerico. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 13.8202 longitude -91.5748. It impacted 101690 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
